blurb: Guests enjoy various rides and attractions with specific height and weight requirements. The park offers go-karts, mini golf, and birthday party packages including rides and food. Group trips and packages are available with advance reservation and deposit.
extraNote: No refunds on P.O.P. bands or tickets · Voucher issued if rain causes park to close within first 30 minutes of POP purchase · In event of rain, no refunds; alternate date for birthday parties · $100 non-refundable deposit required for birthday parties · Group reservations require deposit and must be made in advance · Park may close without notice due to weather
